lines.text: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, scoffed at Jesus, who said God knows their hearts.
A rich man lived in joyous splendor while a beggar named Lazarus lay at his gate, covered with sores.
When Lazarus died, the angels carried him to Isaac's side, and the rich man also died and was buried.
The rich man begged Abraham to send Lazarus to his father's house to warn his three brothers.
Abraham said that if the brothers do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded.
